ambiguity.evidence: change.md fixes the three levels and the always-true/default split, and the owner chose skills/openspec-pipeline (prompt). Research.md Open Questions 2-4 (how always-true is made binding, file layout of layers, @prompts resolver form) are still open, each with several reasonable answers.

novelty.evidence: research.md Architecture Insights: no layers exist; ADR-004 keyword vocabulary (MUST/SHOULD) and ADR-022 fail-closed load check are related precedents, but a layered always-true carrier with precedence has no direct precedent in the repo.

coupling.evidence: research.md: policy.json is read by route.mjs, flow.mjs, state.mjs (deepMerge), and is the public override surface for consumer projects (docs/REFERENCE.md:229, prompts.suffix). Chain branches sit in state, flow, isolation, steps, route, open-pr; ADR-013:141 ties one policy file to both chains.

discovery.evidence: change.md names the OpenSpec definitions and the goal names the folders; research.md already located the prompts, policy keys, openspec.mjs, seven OpenSpec-only tests, docs and ADRs. Some areas were not named and not fully read: open changes' plans and reviews, and any consumer override of prompts.suffix.

volume.evidence: research.md: 24 prompt files in skills/10x-pipeline/prompts/, policy.json os-* and suffix blocks, two SKILL.md files, openspec.mjs, about nine OpenSpec-only and shared tests, AGENTS.md, REFERENCE.md, README.md, ADR-013 amendment, and a CI glob change. Clearly more than 10 files with large mechanical moves.

verification.evidence: Existing tests cover much (rules.test.mjs:104-116 form check, archive, nested-subagents, no-recursive-delete, CI glob in ci.yml:39). Needs new harness parts: a load-time check for always-true blocks, a new prompt resolver test, and a manual check that skills/openspec-pipeline installs and resolves ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR} paths (research open question 5, unproved).

unknowns: Whether an installed plugin keeps the skills/openspec-pipeline folder intact and resolves ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}-relative paths (research open question 5, rows 3.5 and 3.6 unproved).
Whether any consumer project overrides prompts.suffix or other always-true keys today (research open question 7).
